name: linux-pulseaudio-forwarding-smoke
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -eu; test -n "${PULSE_SERVER:-}" && test "${PULSE_SERVER}" = unix:/tmp/devcontainer-pulse/native || { echo "PULSE_SERVER is not configured" >&2; exit 1; }; test -e /tmp/devcontainer-pulse/native || { echo "Host PulseAudio socket is unavailable; check XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulse/native" >&2; exit 1; }; echo "PulseAudio: ${PULSE_SERVER}"; echo "PulseAudio forwarding is available."'
